Only the imaging benefits are in scope; the other rows (labs, dental, hearing and so on) are left out.

The imaging rows on page 5 give costs by setting:
- X-rays and ultrasounds are priced together, so I state one fact per service per setting, using the same quote.
- "Diagnostic Radiology (such as CT, PET Scan, etc.)" is not an exact list of services, so I use `imaging.diagnostic` for it.
- Diagnostic Tests and Procedures (such as a stress test) are not named in the benefit list, so I leave them out.
- "Office or freestanding location" covers two settings, so I state one fact for each.

Each quote has to occur exactly once on its page. "Office or freestanding location: $25 copay" is unique. "Outpatient hospital: $75 copay" is unique. "Office or freestanding location: $100 or $200 copay" is unique. "Outpatient Hospital: $200 or $300 copay" is unique, because its capital H sets it apart.
